> Sports bar on Plano Rd in Richardson, TX with burgers, pool tables, dart boards, shuffleboard and weekly beer specials. Open every day.

## About
Lone Star Grill & Sports Cafe is a spacious bar on Plano Rd in Richardson. We serve sandwiches, fried fare and other grub, with entrees that are reasonably priced and a relaxed setting for you and your friends.
When you're not eating, there's plenty to do. We've got multiple pool tables, dart boards, shuffleboard and Golden Tee. One reviewer came in for a dart tournament and left talking about the burger.
We're rated 4.3 from 446 reviews on Google. Molly Brown is our general manager. Stop by and see for yourself.

## Services
- PBR & Coors Original on tap: Cheap draft beer on Tuesdays and Thursdays. ($2.00)
- PBR & Coors Original all day Wednesdays: Our best beer deal of the week, all day long. ($1.75)
- Jager Bombs: Part of our Jager specials. ($4.75 Jager Bombs)
- Pool tables: Multiple pool tables, ready when you are.
- Darts: Dart boards for casual games, and one reviewer came in for a dart tournament.
- Burgers: One reviewer called ours one of the best burgers they ever had.

## FAQ
Q: What days are you open?
A: Every day. We're open Monday thru Sunday, from lunch until late.

Q: When are the beer specials?
A: PBR & Coors Original on tap are $2.00 on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

Q: Do you have games besides pool?
A: Yes. We've got dart boards, shuffleboard and Golden Tee too.
